x: A Windows PC with Microsoft Excel and Google Chrome, and internet. Your PACS Auto username and password (from your seller) - or start a free trial ( part 3). Your society's PACS website User ID and password (the same ones you use on PACS every day).

Run the setup file PACS_Auto_Setup_<version>.exe you got from your seller. No administrator password is needed. The setup puts a PACS Auto icon on the Desktop and in the Start menu. Your working file is Documents\PACS Auto\PACS_Auto.xlsm. Always open PACS Auto from the icon - not by copying this file somewhere else. Install once. New versions come by themselves - see part 8 (read it: after an update the sheets are empty).

Double-click the PACS Auto icon. The login window opens. 👆 Click any part of the window to jump to its details. Picture: the login window (simplified). Or pick from the list - every part of the login window:

x: Every module is one sheet. At the top is the PACS Auto ribbon; under it, on each sheet, a light-blue settings band; under that, your rows. The parts below are the same on every sheet (shown here on Khad Sale). 👆 Click any button or box in the picture to jump to its details. Picture: the Khad Sale sheet with demo data (invented names). STATUS Meaning What to do DONE Saved on PACS. Nothing. The next run skips this row - it is never made twice. ERROR Not saved. MESSAGE says why. Fix the reason; the next run tries the row again. TESTED Test only - nothing saved. Run Make when ready. SAVING / CHECK Save was pressed, but the result was not clear (e.g. PACS logged out at that moment). Look on PACS. Saved: type DONE in STATUS. Not saved: clear STATUS and run again. These rows are skipped until you decide - so nothing is made twice. To enter a row again, clear its STATUS.

Your data: Documents\PACS Auto\PACS_Auto.xlsm. The app saves it during every run. On your Desktop, folder PACS Auto Files: Backups (copies made before an update and before Clear Sheet), Permits (Khad Sale PDFs) and a folder for the voucher PDFs of Share Deposit, Loan Collection, Cash Payment, Cash Receipt and Other Transfer.

When a new version is ready, the login window shows Update now; in Excel press Check for update (PACS Auto also looks by itself). Excel asks first and tells you what will happen. Say Yes: Excel closes, the update installs and the login window opens again by itself (about a minute). Log in and press Open PACS Auto. Do not click the PACS Auto icon again while it updates. After an update every sheet is EMPTY. Your rows (permits, members, vouchers...) are saved first in a copy of the file in Desktop \ PACS Auto Files \ Backups. Kept as they are: the lists from PACS (godowns, categories, khad, ledgers, PDS items with your rates, loans), your khad and PDS item columns and your choices at the top of the sheets. Rows that are CHECK / SAVING are named in the question - look at them on PACS before you update.

PACS Auto only prepares vouchers. Posting a voucher is always done by you on PACS. Keep Admission No with its leading zeros (0000101, not 101). Do not edit a cell in Excel while a run goes on - Excel then cannot write the results. Press Enter or Esc to leave the cell. The PACS website calls a permit a Bill. In PACS Auto it is always a Permit. A question this guide does not answer: Chat with support.

Type your PACS Auto username and password (not the PACS website ones) and press Log in →. The licence is checked with the PACS Auto server - keep the internet on. What happens Right: you see your licence and Open PACS Auto. Wrong: the window says what is wrong (password, licence ended, version too old...). Good to know Your licence works on this PC and for your society only. A new PC? Ask your seller.
Tick = the username and password are kept (encrypted) on this PC, so next time you only press Log in →. Do not tick it on a PC that other people use.

New to PACS Auto? Press Start your free trial and fill in your name, mobile, State, District, society name, PACS website and a username + password of your choice, then Start free trial →. What happens The trial starts at once - log in with the username and password you chose. Or the window says Request sent: your seller starts the trial; then log in with the same username and password. Good to know One free trial per PC and per PACS society. All modules, no payment now. The link is not shown when this PC already has an account or trials are closed.

The window shows the version on this PC. When a new version is ready, a green strip offers Update now - the update installs and the login window opens again. Inside Excel the same is Check for update.

After the login you see three cards - LICENCE (days left, valid till), PACS ACCOUNT (your society; Locked to: This society only) and APP (version, Excel file found) - and the big green Open PACS Auto →. Press it: Excel opens with your file, already logged in - no second login. Locked to your society. At the first Login to PACS the licence is locked to your society's PACS User ID. It is checked at every start, every 6 hours and before PACS saves anything - PACS logged in to another society stops the run.

Opened the Excel file directly (not from the icon)? Then every button is grey and you see only Please login - on the ribbon and as a green button on the Home sheet. Click it: the same login window opens. Log in there and press Open PACS Auto - this file is logged in by itself.

Looks for a new version of PACS Auto now - it works even before you log in. PACS Auto also looks by itself when the file opens and every 6 hours. What happens Newest already: a message says so. New version: a question tells you what changes - read part 8 first. Good to know Grey during a run.
Your PACS ERP website User ID and password - kept encrypted on this PC, never in the Excel file. Type them once; Login to PACS fills them in for you.

Opens Chrome and logs in to the PACS website. User ID and password are filled in - you type only the captcha in a small window. In the captcha window Type the captcha, press Login. Cannot read it? ↻ New picture. You may also log in directly in Chrome - the window then closes by itself. Good to know Test / Make buttons log in by themselves when needed. PACS logged out later? The next button asks the captcha again. The app works only in its own Chrome tab - your own tabs are not touched. Do not close its tab during a run.
Your PACS server, e.g. mp4.uniteerp.in. Choose the one you use in your own Chrome. Remembered on this PC.

PACS uses this date as the date of what you save - the permit date, the admission date, the voucher date. Type dd-mm-yyyy; empty = today. Changing it logs in to PACS again (captcha). A back date is shown in every "please check" window.
Green Logged in = Chrome is logged in to PACS, you are ready. Red Logged out = not logged in - click it to log in. Before the PACS Auto login this place says Please login.

Opens any PACS Auto sheet - also the ones hidden behind the sheet tabs at the bottom (a small laptop shows only about 10 tabs). The menu has the same groups as this help site; the last item is Home. In the picture: click a module to open its guide.

Fills the PACS page for the selected row in Chrome but does not save it - to check everything first. When to use First time on a new day, or after you change a choice at the top of the sheet. A row that gave an ERROR - to see what PACS says. What happens A "please check" window - Enter = Start. Chrome fills the page. STATUS = TESTED. Nothing is saved on PACS.

Saves the selected row only on PACS. Before it, a "please check" window shows what will be done - read it and click the green button. Enter does not start a saving run. When to use One member at the counter. A row again after you fixed its ERROR. What happens STATUS = DONE + PACS's numbers in the grey columns. Khad Sale: a row that is already DONE is warned in red first.

Saves every row from the selected row down to the first empty row, one by one. Rows already DONE (and CHECK / SAVING rows) are skipped. Asks first in the "please check" window. When to use The normal daily work - click the FIRST row you want, then press it. What happens Rows turn DONE one by one. A refused row = ERROR, the run goes on with the next row.
Waits after the current row. The button then says Resume - press it to go on. While paused, PACS is kept logged in.
The current row finishes - a Save on PACS is never cut in the middle - then the run stops. Next time select the first row that is not DONE and run again.

Deletes all rows of this sheet - to start a new day. It asks first ( No is the default) and saves a copy of the file in Desktop \ PACS Auto Files \ Backups before. Stays The headings, your khad columns, the website lists and the choices at the top. All other sheets. Good to know Not possible while a run is going on. Ctrl + Z cannot bring the rows back - use the copy. Look at SAVING / CHECK rows on PACS first.

Each module has a group of its own buttons, shown only on its sheet - e.g. on Khad Sale: Get Khad Details, Khad Columns, Match khad stock with PACS, Show khad stock from PACS. Every module's guide explains its own buttons - open it from Help → "<sheet> guide".

The light-blue band holds the choices for the whole run of this sheet - Godown, Payment, Loan, a tick like "Save permit PDF"... Every sheet has its own. How to use A dropdown - click and choose. "Type another..." = type your own. A text box (a date, a batch) - click it, a small box asks the text. A tick - click to tick / untick. Good to know Your choices are remembered on this PC. A Godown with 2 or more godowns is empty when the file opens - choose it every time (so you never work in the wrong godown).
Change by themselves while you work: ₹ = the amount saved (DONE rows) on sheets with money · DONE = rows saved · Errors = rows with ERROR or CHECK · Waiting = rows not run yet.

The heading colour tells you who fills a column: Heading colour Meaning Dark blue You type here. A * means it must be filled (e.g. Admission No *). Grey (light-grey cells) The app fills it from PACS. Do not type here. Black - STATUS, MESSAGE The result of each row - see part 6. A note on a heading (the small red corner) says what goes into that column.

A menu: THIS SHEET: <sheet> with "<sheet> guide - English / Hindi" (the guide of the sheet you are on, in Chrome), All guides (every module) (this website) and Chat with support / Report a problem. A sheet without a guide yet (and Home) says "THIS SHEET: no guide yet".

t: Chat with support / Report a problem
x: One chat with PACS Auto support, like WhatsApp - old messages stay above. Write your question and press Send (or Ctrl + Enter). Sent with it Attach screenshot - a picture of your screen, taken when you opened the chat ( see it shows it). It may show member data - it goes only to support; untick it if you do not want it. Attach log - the app's log, so support sees what happened. Good to know Works after the PACS Auto login, not during a run. No internet: "Not sent - no internet" - your text stays, press Send again. You may close the window - the reply comes back here ( Help 1 new).

Support has replied: the Help button gets a red dot and says Help 1 new, and a small box appears at the bottom right - Open chat reads it, Later closes the box. The box never comes during a run; it waits until the run ends.

It works on the PACS page Merchandise → Sales. For every row it opens the Sales page in your Godown, types the member's Admission No, adds each khad with its quantity, chooses the payment (Cash, or Credit on the member's loan account) and saves the permit. Then it writes DONE, the Permit No, the amount and the khad on the permit into your row. The PACS website calls a permit a Bill. In PACS Auto it is always called Permit.

You are logged in to PACS Auto and to PACS - green Logged in (see Getting started). First time on this sheet: press Get Khad Details. It reads your godowns, categories and khad names from PACS (read only). Press it again when PACS gets a new khad.

Each card says what the button or option does, when to use it and what you will see. ↑ Back to the picture Run (selected row) - ribbon Khad Sale - ribbon Settings at the top of the sheet - used for every row of a run Login, Modules, Help - the same on every sheet

Column What goes in SR Your own serial number (not sent to PACS). Admission No * The member's Admission No exactly as on PACS - keep the leading zeros (0000101). Khad columns (DAP, Urea...) The quantity of each khad. Leave it empty if the member does not take that khad. The columns come from PACS ( Category). Member Name Leave it empty - the app fills it from PACS. If you type it, it must match the name on PACS, otherwise no permit is made (a safety check for a wrong Admission No). Remark Your own note (not sent to PACS). Village, Permit No, Permit Amount, Items in Permit Filled by the app after the permit is saved.

1 Type rows → 2 Match stock → 3 Test Permit → 4 Make Bulk Permit → 5 please check → Start → 6 DONE → 7 Sale Voucher Choose the settings at the top - Godown, Category, Payment, Account, Loan. Type the rows. One member per row: Admission No and the quantities. Pasting from your own register: check that each number lands under the right khad. Check the stock - Match khad stock with PACS. Test first - click a row, Test Permit. Make the permits - click the first row, Make Bulk Permit, read the "please check" window, click the green button. Watch each row turn DONE. Need a break? Pause / Stop. Next: the vouchers of these permits in Sale Voucher.

STATUS Meaning What to do DONE Permit saved on PACS. Nothing. The next run skips this row. ERROR Not saved. MESSAGE says why. Fix the reason; the next run tries the row again. TESTED Test only - nothing saved. Run Make Permit when ready. SAVING / CHECK Save was pressed but the result was not clear (e.g. PACS logged out at that moment). Look for this member's permit on PACS. Made: type DONE in STATUS. Not made: clear STATUS and run again. MESSAGE What to do This member has no Loans account On PACS the member has no account of the chosen loan. Open the loan account on PACS, or sell on Cash. The website did not send this member's Loans account list PACS was slow. Run the row again.... 2 KCC Kharif accounts, the first one was used (Loan No...) Only information - the permit is DONE on the first account. Credit Amount Cannot be Greater Than Loan Eligible Amount PACS refused: the member's loan limit is less than the permit. Reduce the quantity or check his limit on PACS. Nothing was saved. Quantity in a hidden khad column Tick that khad in Khad Columns, or clear the quantity. PACS logged out Press the button again - the app logs in again (captcha).

Your Excel file is saved during the run, so a DONE permit is never lost and never made twice. Before every Save the app checks that PACS is still logged in to your society. If PACS refuses a Save, the row is ERROR and a Bulk run goes on with the next member. Video for this chapter: coming soon.

Fills the permit of the selected row on the PACS website in Chrome, but does not save it. Use it to check everything once before you make real permits. When to use First time on a new day, or after you change Godown / Payment / Loan. A member whose row gave an ERROR - to see what PACS says. What happens The "please check" window opens - Enter = Start. Chrome fills member, khad, quantities and payment. STATUS = TESTED. Nothing is saved on PACS.

Makes and saves the permit of the selected row only. Asks first in the "please check" window. When to use One member - e.g. a member who comes to the counter. Making a row again after you fixed its ERROR. What happens "Please check" window - click the green button (Enter does nothing). The permit is saved on PACS. STATUS = DONE + Permit No, Permit Amount, Items in Permit. On a row that is already DONE the window warns you in red and the button says Make permit AGAIN. Press it only if the member really needs a second permit.

Makes permits for every row from the selected row down to the first empty row. DONE rows are skipped. It checks the PACS stock first and asks in the "please check" window. When to use Many members in one go - the normal daily work. Click the FIRST row you want, then press it. What happens Stock is compared with what the rows need. "Please check" window: rows, permits, login date. Rows turn DONE one by one; a refused row = ERROR and the run goes on. Stock short? Permits are made only for the rows before the first row that has no stock. The rows after it wait, and their MESSAGE says why.

During a Bulk run: waits after the current permit. The button then says Resume - press it to go on from the next row. When to use You need Chrome or Excel for a moment (a phone call, check a member on PACS). Good to know A permit being saved is never cut off. While paused, do not change the rows below.

Ends the run. The current permit finishes first (a save is never cut off), then the run stops. When to use You see wrong data in the rows below - stop, fix, run again. Next time Select the first row that is not DONE and press Make Bulk Permit again. DONE rows are skipped anyway.

Deletes all rows of this sheet so you can start a new day. It asks first ( No is the default) and keeps a copy of the file in Desktop \ PACS Auto Files \ Backups. Stays The headings and your khad columns (shown and hidden). The lists from PACS and your choices at the top. All other sheets. Good to know Not possible while a run is going on. Ctrl + Z cannot bring the rows back - use the backup copy. Look at SAVING / CHECK rows on PACS before you clear.

Reads your godowns, categories and khad names from PACS (read only - nothing is saved there) and adds a column for every khad. When to use The first time on this sheet. PACS got a new khad or a new godown. What happens Godown and Category lists at the top are filled. New khad columns come after the old ones - never removed.

Choose which khad columns you see and their order - when too many khad push Member Name and STATUS off the screen. In the window Tick = shown. No tick = hidden, kept far right - never deleted. ▲ ▼ = order. Website order = PACS's order. Tick all / Untick all, then OK. Good to know A khad with a quantity in a row that is not DONE cannot be unticked ("in use: row N"). Locked while a run is going on. A paste into a hidden column warns you - press Ctrl + Z.

Compares what your waiting rows need with the PACS stock in the chosen Godown - ENOUGH or SHORT for every khad. Nothing is saved. When to use Before a big Bulk run. Short? Bring the stock in on PACS first, or reduce the quantities - rows from the first short row will not get a permit.
Only shows the PACS stock of every khad in the Godown / Category chosen at the top. Zero stock is red.

The godown the khad goes out from. The list comes from Get Khad Details. One godown: chosen for you. Two or more: empty when the file opens - choose it every time (never remembered, so you never sell from the wrong godown by mistake). Khad Sale has its own Godown - Sale Voucher and Sale Cancel have their own.
The khad category, e.g. Fertilizer. Choosing it adds a column for every khad of this Godown + Category (columns are never removed). Remembered on this PC.
Credit = the permit goes on the member's account (choose Account + Loan). Cash = paid in cash - Account and Loan are not used. Remembered on this PC.
The PACS account type for a Credit permit - usually Loans. The same names as on the PACS Sales page.

Which loan the permit goes on, e.g. KCC Kharif. Pick from the list or Type another... Member with one loan account: that one is used. Several loans: the one you chose here. Two accounts of the same loan: the first one is used and MESSAGE says so. No account of this loan: the row is ERROR "This member has no Loans account".
Tick = after every permit its PDF is saved on your Desktop, one folder per day. No tick = no PDF (a little faster). Remembered on this PC.
Change by themselves while you work: ₹ Total = amount of the permits made (DONE) · DONE = permits saved · Errors = rows with ERROR · Waiting = rows not run yet.
Opens Chrome and logs in to the PACS website - you type only the captcha. Make Permit / Test also log in by themselves when needed.
Your PACS ERP website User ID and password - kept encrypted on this PC, never in the Excel file.
Your PACS server, e.g. mp4.uniteerp.in. Choose the one you use in your own Chrome.
PACS uses this date as the permit date. Type dd-mm-yyyy; empty = today. Changing it logs in to PACS again (captcha). A back date is shown in the "please check" window.
Green = Chrome is logged in to PACS. Red = not logged in - click it to log in.
Looks for a new version of PACS Auto now. PACS Auto also looks by itself when the file opens and every 6 hours.
Opens any PACS Auto sheet - e.g. Sale Voucher after your permits.
This guide (English / Hindi), all guides, and Chat with support - send a question or a problem with a screenshot.

It works on the PACS page Merchandise → Sale Voucher. It reads PACS's list of permits waiting for a voucher (for your Godown and Payment), and for each permit - oldest first - it ticks it, saves the voucher and checks that the permit has left the waiting list. Every voucher gets a row in the sheet. PACS Auto only prepares (saves) the sale voucher. Posting the voucher is always done by you on PACS.
Logged in to PACS - green Logged in (see Getting started). The permits are made (for example with Khad Sale), or the returns with Sale Return.

All columns are filled by the app - you type nothing here. Column What the app writes Activity Sales or Sale Returns (the choice at the top). Permit No, Permit Date The permit (PACS's Bill No.) and its date. Godown, Payment The choices of the run. Amount PACS's own amount after its round-off - the app never rounds by itself. Batch ID The new batch made for this Save (Credit, Cash and Credit). Empty for Cash. Saved On Date and time of the Save. STATUS, MESSAGE The result - see part 7.

1 Activity, Godown, Payment → 2 Check pending voucher → 3 Make voucher → 4 please check → click → 5 DONE → 6 Post on PACS Choose Activity, Godown and Payment at the top of the sheet. Check pending voucher - a read-only look at the permits waiting. Nothing is saved. Make voucher - the app reads the list again and shows the "please check" window. Read it and click the green button (e.g. "Make 3 sale vouchers"). Watch the rows turn DONE, one per permit. Need a break? Pause / Stop - they act between two Saves. Post the vouchers on PACS yourself.

STATUS Meaning What to do DONE Sale voucher saved; the permit left PACS's waiting list. Post it on PACS when you are ready. ERROR Not saved. MESSAGE says why. The run stopped there. Fix the reason and press Make voucher again - the permit is still in the waiting list. SAVING / CHECK Save was pressed, the result was not clear. The run stopped there. Press Check pending voucher: a permit no longer waiting becomes DONE by itself. Still waiting = not saved: the next Make voucher makes it (a new row) - you may delete the old CHECK row. MESSAGE / window What to do No permits are waiting for a sale voucher (Godown...,..., Activity...) Every permit of this Godown + Payment already has a voucher - or the Godown / Payment / Activity is not the one of your permits. Choose the Godown / the Payment Method (Sale Voucher) at the top of the sheet first. Choose it in the band and press the button again. Website message:... PACS refused the Save. Read PACS's words; fix it on PACS (e.g. day end, batch) and run again. Save was pressed but the permits are still pending. Website said:... CHECK - see the STATUS table. Still pending after Save. Website said:... Some permits of the Save stayed in the list. Run Make voucher again. Batch Creation:... PACS refused to make a batch. Check the batch / day on PACS. Godown '...' is not on the Sale Voucher page Choose the godown exactly as PACS shows it. The Sale Voucher page did not open (are you still logged in?) Press Login to PACS, then the button again.

One permit per Save, oldest first - the same order a person would follow on PACS. The app works on PACS's waiting list, not on rows you type - so a permit can never get two vouchers from the app. Saved vouchers are final on PACS; posting is yours. Video for this chapter: coming soon.

Shows the permits still waiting for a sale voucher on PACS for the chosen Activity, Godown and Payment - Permit No, date and amount, oldest first. Read only - nothing is saved. When to use Before Make voucher - to see how many permits and how much will be made. After a CHECK row - to let the app look again. What happens The window lists the permits with their total. Waiting at the top of the sheet gets the number + amount. A CHECK / SAVING row whose permit is no longer waiting becomes DONE by itself.

Makes the sale voucher of every waiting permit, one by one, oldest first - one permit per Save. It reads PACS's list again and asks first in the "please check" window. What happens "Please check" window: Godown, Activity, Payment, permits, saves, login date, batch. Cancel has the focus - click the green button (e.g. "Make 3 sale vouchers"). Each saved permit gets a DONE row with its amount, Batch ID and time. At the end: "Sale vouchers made for 3 of 3 permit(s)." Good to know The selected cell does not matter - this button works on PACS's waiting list, not on the sheet rows. A refused Save (ERROR) or an unclear one (CHECK) stops the run - the message says why. Fix it and press Make voucher again: the permit is still in PACS's list. Batch: for Credit and Cash and Credit PACS needs a batch - the app makes a new batch for every Save (the Generate button of PACS's Batch Creation window) and writes the Batch ID into the row. Cash needs no batch.
During Make voucher: waits after the current voucher (between two Saves). The button then says Resume - press it to go on. After a pause the app reads PACS's list again.
The current voucher finishes (a Save is never cut off), then the run stops - the message starts with "Stopped by you." The permits not made stay in PACS's list for the next Make voucher.

Deletes all log rows of this sheet when it gets long. It asks first ( No is the default) and keeps a copy of the file in Desktop \ PACS Auto Files \ Backups. The vouchers on PACS are not touched. Good to know Not possible while a run is going on. Ctrl + Z cannot bring the rows back - use the copy. Before you clear Press Check pending voucher once - CHECK rows that were saved turn DONE.
Sales (the default) = vouchers of normal permits. Sale Returns = vouchers of returned permits (made in the Sale Return sheet). The Activity is written in every row.
The godown of the permits. This sheet has its own Godown - choosing it here does not change Khad Sale or Sale Cancel. With 2 or more godowns it is empty when the file opens: choose it every time.
Cash, Credit or Cash and Credit - the same payment the permits were made with. Only permits of this Godown + Payment are shown and made. Remembered on this PC.

It works on the PACS page Merchandise → Sale Cancel (Sale Type: Sales). For every Permit No it cancels the whole permit - every khad line, the full quantity - with the Reason you chose, then writes DONE, the reason and the time into the row. A cancelled permit cannot be brought back. Read the "please check" window carefully. Sale Cancel never changes your Khad Sale sheet. If you keep a note there, change it yourself.

Logged in to PACS - green Logged in (see Getting started). The permit's sale voucher is not made yet. PACS lists only such permits for cancelling. You know the Permit No (PACS calls it Bill No.) and roughly the date of the permit.

👆 Click any button or box in the picture to jump to its details. Picture: the Sale Cancel sheet with demo data (invented names). Every button and box is a link. Or pick from the list - every button and option of this sheet:

Settings at the top of the sheet - used for the whole run Login, Modules, Help - the same on every sheet

Column What goes in Permit No * The only column you type: the Permit No (PACS's Bill No.) of each permit to cancel, one per row. Member Name Filled by the app from PACS (Sold To) before anything is cancelled - check it. Permit Amount Total of the permit on PACS. Items in Permit The khad on the permit. Reason The reason sent to PACS. Cancelled On When the app cancelled it. STATUS, MESSAGE The result - see part 7.

1 Type Permit No → 2 Godown, Reason, Dates → 3 Cancel Permits → 4 App finds them on PACS → 5 please check → click → 6 DONE Type the Permit No of each permit to cancel, one per row. Choose Godown, Reason and the From / To dates (or Dates). Press Cancel Permits. Look-up (read only): the app fills Member Name, Permit Amount and Items in Permit. Nothing is cancelled yet. The "please check" window lists the permits with member, khad and amount. Check them, then click the red button. Each cancelled permit becomes DONE. A CHECK stops the run so you can look first.

STATUS Meaning What to do DONE Cancelled on PACS (or it was already cancelled). Nothing. The next run skips it. ERROR Not cancelled. MESSAGE says why. The run goes on with the next permit. Fix the reason; the next Cancel Permits tries it again. SAVING / CHECK Save was pressed, the result was not clear. The run stops so you can look first. Look at the permit on PACS. Cancelled: type DONE in STATUS. Not cancelled: clear STATUS and run again. MESSAGE What to do Not in the PACS list for <dates> (Godown...): another date or godown, already cancelled, or its sale voucher is made. Nothing was cancelled. Check the From / To dates and the Godown. If the sale voucher of the permit is already made, PACS does not allow the cancel here. Already cancelled on PACS (every khad line shows as returned) Nothing - the row is DONE. Permit... is also in row... - it is cancelled only once The same Permit No is typed twice. Remove the extra row. Website says the cancel needs approval:... (CHECK) Your society uses approvals: approve the cancel on PACS, then type DONE. Permit... now shows '...', not '...' - nothing was cancelled The permit changed on PACS after the look-up. Check it on PACS. Website did not cancel the permit:... PACS refused. Read PACS's words in the MESSAGE. Choose the Godown / Choose or type the Reason at the top of the sheet first (Sale Cancel). Choose it in the band and press Cancel Permits again. Every permit in the Sale Cancel sheet is already DONE or CHECK - nothing to cancel.

The whole permit is always cancelled, and Sale Type is always Sales. A returned permit goes through Sale Return. If PACS logs out before a Save, the app logs in again once (captcha) and goes on; after a Save it never presses Save a second time. Before every Save the app checks that PACS is still logged in to your society. Video for this chapter: coming soon.

Cancels on PACS every permit of this sheet that is not DONE (Sale type Sales, with the Godown, Reason and dates chosen at the top). The selected row does not matter. It finds the permits on PACS first and asks before cancelling. What happens Look-up (read only): Member Name, Permit Amount and Items in Permit are filled, MESSAGE "Found on PACS - not cancelled yet". "Please check" window with the permits. Go back has the focus and Enter does nothing - click the red button (e.g. "Cancel 2 permits"). One permit per Save. Each one becomes DONE with Reason and Cancelled On. Skipped Rows already DONE, and CHECK / SAVING rows (look at them on PACS first). A Permit No typed twice - the second row gets ERROR. A permit not found on PACS - ERROR (part 7). The window names the skipped ones in red.

A calendar opens under the button: click the From date, then the To date (the days between are shaded), then OK. Today jumps to today. Days after today cannot be chosen. The two date boxes at the top get the dates.
During Cancel Permits: waits after the current permit. The button then says Resume - press it to go on.

The current permit finishes (a Save is never cut off), then the run stops - the message starts with "Stopped by you." The permits not cancelled keep "Found on PACS - not cancelled yet"; the next Cancel Permits takes them again.

Deletes all rows of this sheet. It asks first ( No is the default) and keeps a copy of the file in Desktop \ PACS Auto Files \ Backups. Not possible while a run is going on; Ctrl + Z cannot bring the rows back.
The godown the permits were made in. This sheet has its own Godown - it does not change Khad Sale or Sale Voucher. With 2 or more godowns it is empty when the file opens: choose it every time.

One of: Wrong entry, Wrong member, Wrong khad / quantity, Member did not take khad, Duplicate permit - or Type another... for your own words. It is sent to PACS with every cancel and written into the row.

The dates of the permits - PACS lists the permits of these days. Empty = today. Click a box: a small box asks the date - type it like 01-11-2026 (01/11/2026 works too). Or press Dates on the ribbon. Not taken A text that is no date, or a day that does not exist. A date in the future. From date after To date. Tip Not sure of the day? Take a wider range - only the Permit Nos you typed are cancelled.
DONE = permits cancelled · Errors = rows with ERROR or CHECK · Waiting = Permit Nos not run yet. This sheet has no ₹ tile.
Opens Chrome and logs in to the PACS website - you type only the captcha. If PACS logs out before a Save, Cancel Permits logs in again once (captcha) and goes on. More
Your PACS ERP website User ID and password - kept encrypted on this PC, never in the Excel file.
Your PACS server, e.g. mp4.uniteerp.in. Choose the one you use in your own Chrome.

The date PACS is logged in with - the day of the cancel on PACS. It is not the permit date (that is From / To date at the top of the sheet). Empty = today; changing it logs in again (captcha). A back date is shown in the "please check" window.
Green = Chrome is logged in to PACS. Red = not logged in - click it to log in.
Looks for a new version of PACS Auto now. Read Updates first: after an update the sheets are empty (a copy is kept).
Opens any PACS Auto sheet - e.g. Khad Sale or Sale Voucher.
